observations: Manifest, exact three source hashes and all three baselines independently match. Wrapper delta only passes existing private typed receipt context into the collector.

Original qualificationJob applies and queries the same Job limits, now requiring exact expected flags. Collector then validates copied provenance, actual native/helper file hashes, environment hash, exact ordered argv and hash, fixed plan roots/nonce/port/cases, template/native hash, source/receipt naming, boot and canonical epoch.

Intent is a distinct bounded32KiB PREPARED_INTENT_ONLY record under existing private receipt root. It contains no model prompt or raw environment/config/auth content; hashes and path metadata are not a readiness grant.

Production writer uses O_EXCL0600, full-write check, Sync and Close, bounded byte-equal readback, context check in writer and again immediately before launch. All error branches close owned pipes and defer Job close; no launch fallback, evidence deletion or retry is introduced.

Prelaunch intent path/hash are recorded only after successful persistence. Final capture requires that exact path, regular bounded original file, same bytes digest, canonical JSON/schema/phase and matching immutable context; mutable post-controls/case results are excluded from the prelaunch-context comparison.

Final persistence succeeds before ensureLaunch publishes observation. A final-only or altered intent cannot qualify through the production flow. No public DTO, exported fake constructor, receipt-to-READY import or model-PID fabrication is added.

Private hooks are used by trusted Go tests only. Production collectQualification always passes empty hooks and uses original launch with recorded arguments. Fake-child tests deliberately substitute their own test-binary argv, so they are cleanup/linkage fixtures rather than actual Native-argv execution proof.

New fixture sources cover exclusive prior record, short-write/Sync/Close/readback/marshal/size faults, cancel-beforelaunch, same-Job ordering, durable partial preservation and final-intent tampering. No test run was performed by this reviewer.
